card.name: The word capsule in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The word "capsule" (sometimes "packet" or "system") right after "the" or "sprinkled" in administration directions, especially opening or sprinkling capsule contents.

modes.label: Capsule handling
modes.description: "capsule" after "the" in directions for sprinkling, opening or swallowing capsules.
modes.example: the<< capsule>> contents may be administered with a small amount

modes.label: Other dosage forms
modes.description: Packet or transdermal system named as the item being handled or removed.
modes.example: Open the SOLOSEC<< packet>> by folding over the corner

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Final part of a drug name such as zoledronic or probenecid.
modes.example: Coadministration of probenec<<id>> with meropenem is not recommended.
